name: observation-journey-v1
navigationResets: navigate to fresh fixture app after every round, including final round; require full fallback against previous document baseline
initialState: initial full observation counted in both strategies
capture: At every state obtain forced full and delta-since-previous-state responses through each actual transport. Keep independent previous baseline for each transport; no mutation occurs between paired observations. Compare exact reconstructed snapshot text, ordered ref IDs, refs count, URL, title, truncation/depth metadata and document ID; mode/full reset metadata retained. Count initial and reset full responses in aggregate denominator.

tokenizer.serialization: canonical compact sorted JSON of actual consumer result payload; text token counts also retained
tokenizer.scope: fixed-encoding observation response tokens only; no GPT-6 billing-tokenizer or whole-agent end-to-end token claim

gate: All 16 states and3navigation resets succeed semantically and reconstruct per transport; aggregate delta strategy tokens <=50% forced-full strategy tokens. Report every transport separately; do not infer one transport from another. Retain per-state and aggregate full/delta token and byte totals, modes, changed/reset counts, raw outputs, failures and cleanup.
taskSemantics: Each round validates public HTML payload, JSON payload and matching server tokens, JS-computed DOM totals, native trusted fill/click and exactly one successful server receipt. Public read bundle uses candidate public_http route.
